description: Send a message to an agent on another of the owner's computers. Use this to hand over work, ask a question or report back without opening a remote session or typing into a screen. The message is delivered through the owner's AttachDesk account, only between computers on that account, and the receiving agent reads it with jrd_message_read. It records which computer sent it; set `label` to say which agent you are. Fails when the other computer is not on this account or does not have AI control turned on.

label.description: Who is sending, shown to the reader, for example "Claude on the laptop". Up to 80 characters.

to.description: Name, device code or device_id of the computer to send to (see jrd_list_devices).

name: jrd_message_send
